facts.text: GaAs Solar Array Wings was deployed at 433 Eros — Himeros Region during NEAR Shoemaker in 2001.
Four 1.8 x 1.2 m fixed gallium arsenide solar panel wings producing 1,800 W at 1.0 AU, canted to capture oblique solar rays.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the lunar environment.
Maintained continuous electrical bus voltage during surface contact despite extreme low Sun elevation angles.
Status: Remains preserved in the arid regolith at 433 Eros — Himeros Region.
Pioneered durable gallium arsenide photovoltaic cells for deep-space missions beyond Earth orbit.
